text: for the edges, i see there is boundary hinge mount contact, what are the 4 ? so i know which to use best
resolution: Explained the four durable logical-edge purposes from the active editor contract and gave vehicle-specific selection guidance: boundary for outlines/seams, hinge for pivot axes, mount for fixed attachment interfaces, and contact for mating/closing/stop interfaces. Clarified that the roles currently preserve author intent for future rigging/assembly consumers rather than creating mechanics by themselves.
